title: Connect arrays, transformations and explicit state

stages.title: Report the completed environment
stages.evidence: Independent row sums, actual device and package versions
stages.expected: PASS stage 1 and all earlier stages
stages.diagnosis: Import success alone does not identify the device of the output.

stages.title: Process observations with a mask
stages.evidence: Independent statistics, singleton and constant columns, changed shape and input purity
stages.expected: PASS stage 2 and all earlier stages
stages.diagnosis: Padded rows must not enter either the numerator or count.

stages.title: Compile a batch of gradients
stages.evidence: Two parameter settings, independent derivatives, singleton and vector batches
stages.expected: PASS stage 3 and all earlier stages
stages.diagnosis: Keep parameters shared while mapping observation and target axes together.

stages.title: Replay a batched simulation
stages.evidence: Independent update order, saved keys/state and fresh-process continuation
stages.expected: PASS stage 4 and all earlier stages
stages.diagnosis: A reused or missing random key changes the future even when the saved positions match.

rubric: Describe the environment of a completed result
Preserve observation/feature axes and exclude invalid observations
Explain grad, vmap and jit through independent per-example derivatives
Make random keys and update order explicit
Replay a continued trajectory in a fresh process
setupNote: Run from the extracted bundle’s top folder with requirements-cpu.txt installed. Four stages connect the first four phases before the regression capstone.
